title: Bioluminescent Terrarium Material Lab
description: The user manages a bioluminescent terrarium where a translucent plant grows inside an iridescent abalone shell. By adjusting environmental parameters like light wavelength, moisture level, and shell orientation, the user tunes the interplay between the plant's diffuse transmission and the shell's iridescence to achieve a target visual spectrum displayed as a color swatch panel.
prompt: Create a single HTML file using Three.js r170 (via importmap from cdn.jsdelivr.net) that implements a Bioluminescent Terrarium Material Lab. Load DiffuseTransmissionPlant.glb and IridescenceAbalone.glb using GLTFLoader. Scale the abalone shell up to act as a bowl/terrarium base and position the plant model inside it so it appears to be growing from the shell. Set up a PerspectiveCamera at a 35-degree angle looking down at the terrarium, with OrbitControls limited to a hemisphere above the ground plane. Add a warm-toned DirectionalLight, a subtle AmbientLight, and a colored PointLight positioned below the plant to simulate bioluminescence shining upward through the translucent leaves. Create a dat.gui or custom HTML control panel on the right side with these interactive parameters: (1) Light Wavelength slider (380-780nm) that maps to the PointLight color using a visible spectrum conversion, (2) Light Intensity slider (0-3) controlling the PointLight intensity, (3) Moisture slider (0-1) that adjusts the plant material's transmission factor and opacity, (4) Shell Rotation slider (0-360) that rotates the abalone shell around Y-axis changing iridescence viewing angle, (5) Iridescence Intensity slider (0-1) modifying the shell material's iridescenceIntensity property, (6) Environment Exposure slider (0-2) adjusting renderer toneMappingExposure. Display a target color swatch panel in the top-right corner showing 3 randomly generated target colors. The user must match the overall scene appearance by tuning all 6 parameters. Add a Sample Color button that reads the center pixel of the renderer and compares it against the current target color with a deltaE threshold of 15. When a target is matched, mark it with a green checkmark and advance to the next. Track and display the number of matched targets out of 3. Use a dark background with subtle fog for atmosphere. Ensure all materials from the GLB files are preserved and enhanced with the interactive properties.
